description: Find top AI-tagged example posts for a funnel stage (and optional format) to model a draft on: inspiration library (by likes), post templates, or the creator's own posts (by impressions). Returns excerpt, stage, format, media type, and metrics. Read-only.

creator_id.description: Required for source=own when the key can access several creators.

format.description: Optional taxonomy format id, e.g. case_study, framework, hot_take.

name: bamf.find_funnel_examples
